counterexample.observed: The retry finds the cached result, deletes the queue entry, and leaves ORDER-42 accepted with no stored result while one package exists.
sequence: acquire an exclusive write lock on the order database from outside the worker
worker reserves a package and writes the result to the response cache
terminate the worker before it can commit the order-store fulfillment
run the worker again to process the queued retry

invariants: each order reserves at most one fulfillment package
an order with no queued work is fulfilled
a fulfilled order records its reservation result
the order result identifies the reservation package
name: retry-cache-commit-order-workflow
plausible_wrong_fix: Disable or clear the retry cache so the worker always calls the fulfillment provider again. The stuck order becomes fulfilled, but the provider is not idempotent, so a retry after the same crash reserves a second package.
